summary: ansible-vault encrypts files or single variables. Store a vault password in a file, then run ansible-vault encrypt_string with --vault-id user@file (or @prompt) and --name ansible_password; --vault-id supports multiple passwords.
questions: How do I encrypt my network device SSH password?
How do I encrypt a single variable with ansible-vault?
Can I be prompted for the vault password instead of using a file?

answer_card.title: Encrypt a password with ansible-vault
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Save a vault password:
   ```console
   echo "my-ansible-vault-pw" > ~/my-ansible-vault-pw-file
   ```
2. Encrypt the SSH password:
   ```console
   ansible-vault encrypt_string --vault-id my_user@~/my-ansible-vault-pw-file 'VyOS_SSH_password' --name 'ansible_password'
   ```
   Or `--vault-id my_user@prompt` to type it.

`--vault-id` lets you use different vault passwords for different users or access levels.
